svg.title: SQ38576A reference circuit
svg.desc: 11 W auxiliary power supply built around the SQ38576A secondary-side-regulated flyback switcher, redrawn from Figure 15 of the datasheet with its designators. The AC input goes through the diode bridge BD1 to two bulk capacitors CE1 and CE2 in series. The bus feeds the top of the transformer primary T1 and, through three 1 MΩ resistors R12, R13 and R14, the CONT pin, which also has the capacitor C5 and the resistor R11 to ground. A clamp made of the capacitor C4 in parallel with the resistor R9, then R7 and R8 in parallel, then the diode D1, sits between the bus and the drain node. The switcher U1 has its DRAIN pins on the bottom of the primary. Its ISEN pin goes to ground through R5 in parallel with R6. An auxiliary winding feeds VCC through the diode D2 and the resistor R10, with the capacitors CE3 and C3 on VCC. The COMP pin has the capacitor C2 and the phototransistor of the optocoupler PC1. On the secondary, the diode DS1 with a snubber RS7 and CS2 across it feeds the output capacitors CO1 and CO2. The optocoupler LED with RS1 and RS2, the TL431 shunt regulator US1 and a divider RS4, RS5 and RS6 regulate the output.
